title: Swedish rapper, Undexd releases a must hear sound titled “Better me”
htmlContent:
Swedish-based artist, Undexd is a talented singer, rapper, and songwriter making a name for himself in the music industry. His raw talents can be seen so brightly in his recent track “Better Me.” The talented artist is trying to learn about his craft to become the best in his work.

Undexd “Better me” is about trying to bounce back from a heartbreak and all the emotions and damage that come with it. The Pop Rap vibe is elevated with a production that takes you to another stratosphere that meshes well with the vocals, which create the perfect storm of must-hear music.
